_notes.source: code (default: comments and strings removed) | raw (signal lives inside a string or comment)
_notes.window: 0 | <n> | 'statement' — multi-line rules. CAUTION: 'statement' ends at a semicolon and is only usable in languages that have one. In Python and similar, use a single-line check or a fixed window. Pair it with 'anchor' to pin the finding to the current line.
_notes.scope_from / scope_to: restrict to a named block, e.g. only the up() body of a migration
_notes.except_values: values of the first capture group that are allowed
_notes.skip_file_if: regex; when it matches the file, the rule is skipped
_notes.not_applicable: principles this stack genuinely does not have. Silence by declaration, not by omission.
